prompt:
Produce one clean production image asset using your highest available image quality. Follow the attached approved crop exactly; this is asset reconstruction, not a new design.

Opaque, portrait 1024x1536. Reference: `.impeccable/build/crops/today.png`, and the full comp for context.

Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset at the target aspect ratio. This is a photographic or illustrated image region. Output the same subject, same framing, same lighting. Preserve silhouette, composition, perspective, palette (#abd7f4, #101010, #282833), lighting, material, and texture exactly. Remove every piece of UI text, label, caption, button, and interface chrome that is not part of the artwork itself. Remove letterboxing, borders, card corners, drop shadows, and any layout background that the page will draw in code. Do not add objects. Do not change the concept. Do not restyle. The artwork fills the whole frame edge to edge at the same scale as the reference; no margins, no border, no background band. Region: photoreal white robot selfie, face and shoulders, blue head plate, pale sky.

Additional requirements:
- Remove the yellow focus brackets, the pink circle, the pink arrow, and the robot thumb at the bottom. None of them are part of this photo.
- The image is the phone's front-camera view, and it's taller than the crop: extend the same pale overcast sky above, and more of the robot's chest and reaching arm below, so that the crop's area sits in the upper middle of the frame.
- The robot's head plate is a clean saturated blue, as in the reference, and the plate is one distinct flat-faced part, so it can be recolored precisely.

Output 1024x1536 portrait, fully opaque. Attachment 1 is the exact artwork crop to reproduce, attachment 2 is context only. Only the actual selfie photo fills the output: no webpage, phone, interface, annotation, external hand or thumb. Keep the expressionless white ceramic robot and dark sensor cluster exactly as approved. Extend pale overcast sky above and the same chest and image-right reaching arm below; preserve the approved subject scale and pose. The separate foreground thumb visible at the very bottom of the crop is removed; the robot's own reaching arm IN the selfie remains.
